incompatibilities.legacy_levels: No native creation or migration profile below 2016 is specified; inherited 2016 behavior still requires qualification.
incompatibilities.level_2025: 2025 DC OS can participate in a Microsoft 2016-level reference forest, but 2025 functional-level features such as 32-KiB database pages are outside this profile. No fictitious 2019 or 2022 functional level.
incompatibilities.frs: No FRS fallback. First-production GPO/SYSVOL must meet the supported profile; mixed Windows-DC coexistence requires separately qualified DFSR behavior. A fresh all-Babel topology still requires its complete GPO/SYSVOL consistency/replication contract.
incompatibilities.optional_features: PAM/MIM, PKINIT freshness, smart-card/password-secret policy, Protected Users and authentication-policy/silo behavior must be inventoried and qualified or explicitly block the applicable claim; a level label does not implement them. No silent legacy-crypto fallback.
incompatibilities.mixed_dc: No mixed Windows/Babel-DC or trust/migration claim in the initial creation design. Reference Windows DC OS compatibility is not Babel coexistence evidence.
incompatibilities.client_os: Functional level constrains DC behavior, not workstation/member-server OS. Preserve Windows, Linux SSSD/Kerberos and macOS client profiles with separate exact-build qualification.
incompatibilities.rollback: No native raise or lower transition. Conditional Microsoft rollback exceptions are not implemented. Domain cannot be below its forest level; a restore must reconcile keys, SYSVOL and replica epochs, not only change a number.

references.review: Reviewed 18 November 2026. Primary current functional-level/OS distinction, 2016 features, inherited behavior, forest/domain ordering and 2025 level. This takes precedence over the stale no-levels-since-2016 sentence in the upgrade article.

Reviewed 18 November 2026 for conditional level rollback and upgrade/recovery boundaries. Its no-new-levels-since-2016 sentence conflicts with the pinned current level table; it is not used to deny the existence of the 2025 level. Babel implements none of its conditional rollback exceptions.

worked_changes.scope: Normative Phase 0 worked design for schema; implementation and runtime qualification remain separate.
worked_changes.forward: Exclusive, bounded migration authority checks schema versions, a coherent backup and dry-run compatibility before staging a versioned migration.
worked_changes.interrupted: Power fails after staging a new attribute index but before the schema checkpoint.
worked_changes.recovery: Stop incompatible writes; read the durable checkpoint, resume idempotently or restore the coherent backup into isolation. Verify matching rules, counts and ACLs before serving. A partial migration never advertises the new schema.
worked_changes.production_impact: Block the corresponding production operation until implementation, failure/recovery evidence and explicit release review are qualified.

impacts.security: Preserve authority, secret custody and denied-operation behavior through interruption.
impacts.capacity: Bound authority/lock duration and include backup/staging/replay resources in the operation budget.
impacts.formats: Version affected formats; preserve stable identities and refuse partial/new-version state.
impacts.protocols: Do not advertise completed or compatible behavior before coherent recovery.
impacts.api: Return an explicit failure/incomplete state; do not acknowledge an uncertain mutation as success.

evidence_invalidation.rerun: Invalidate affected observations; regenerate the compatibility/evidence binding and rerun positive, denial, interruption and recovery cases against the new source/profile. Keep old failed/unrun results visible.

worked_changes.scope: Normative Phase 0 worked design for credential_keys; implementation and runtime qualification remain separate.
worked_changes.forward: Version key classes and custody, test escrow access, enter a dual-read interval, write only with the new class, verify recovery, then explicitly retire old material.
worked_changes.interrupted: The provider disappears after new-key writes but before old-key retirement.
worked_changes.recovery: Deny affected secret operations, retain both encrypted generations, recover through the reviewed provider/escrow procedure and verify old/new reads before resuming. No plaintext fallback or silent weaker provider; never retire the only recoverable key.

worked_changes.scope: Normative Phase 0 worked design for domain_restore; implementation and runtime qualification remain separate.
worked_changes.forward: Validate a coherent directory/SYSVOL/keys/schema/replication backup and start the restored DC on an isolated network.
worked_changes.interrupted: The restored snapshot contains an old invocation/USN view while peers have accepted password changes and deletions.
worked_changes.recovery: Quarantine the restored instance. Establish the protocol-qualified restore epoch/invocation procedure, reconcile revocation/deletion and rejoin from a qualified source before service. If retained history is insufficient, rebuild. A VM snapshot or SQL restart alone never proves domain recovery.

worked_changes.scope: Normative Phase 0 worked design for gpo; implementation and runtime qualification remain separate.
worked_changes.forward: Stage policy content, ACLs, directory/SYSVOL versions and publication state before declaring a coherent policy.
worked_changes.interrupted: The directory transaction succeeds but SYSVOL publication or ACL installation fails.
worked_changes.recovery: Hide the incomplete publication from coherent policy reads, retain an explicit pending state and reconcile or revert both sides under the publication authority. Verify hashes/ACLs/versions before exposing it. Ordinary copying is not DFSR or Windows policy evidence.
